# laravel_cloud_applications (Data Source)

Lists the organization's applications, optionally filtered by name, region and slug. Use it to reference an application that is not managed in this configuration, such as one created in the dashboard or by another Terraform workspace.

~> **Beta:** This provider is in beta and may change between releases.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "laravel_cloud_applications" "all" {}

# Filters match as substrings, so pick the exact match out of the list.
data "laravel_cloud_applications" "shop" {
  name   = "shop"
  region = "us-east-2"
}

locals {
  shop = one([for a in data.laravel_cloud_applications.shop.applications : a if a.name == "shop"])
}

output "shop_default_environment_id" {
  value = local.shop.default_environment_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only list applications whose name contains this value. The API matches it as a substring.
- `region` (String) Only list applications whose region contains this value, such as `us-east-2`. The API matches it as a substring.
- `slug` (String) Only list applications whose slug contains this value. The API matches it as a substring.

### Read-Only

- `applications` (Attributes List) Matching applications. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--applications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `applications`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the application was created.
- `default_environment_id` (String) ID of the application's default (production) environment.
- `framework` (String) Framework of the default environment, as Laravel Cloud detected it (such as laravel, nextjs).
- `id` (String) Application ID.
- `language` (String) Language of the default environment (such as php, javascript).
- `name` (String) Application name.
- `region` (String) Cloud region (such as us-east-1).
- `repository` (String) Source code repository, in owner/name form. Null when the application has no repository.
- `repository_default_branch` (String) Default branch of the repository.
- `root_directory` (String) Subdirectory of the repository the application lives in. Null for the repository root.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly slug.
- `source_control_provider_type` (String) Source control provider of the repository (github, gitlab, gitlab_self_hosted or bitbucket). Null without a connected repository.
